channel.title: MindExtract
channel.description: MindExtract — download and transcribe video from anywhere

item.title: Version 2.1.1
item.description:
What's New in 2.1.1

  • About, clarified — Settings now includes a responsible-use note and open-source acknowledgements with licenses for the components MindExtract builds on (yt-dlp, FFmpeg, WhisperKit, Sparkle)
  • Clearer privacy wording — nothing leaves your Mac unless you explicitly choose a cloud AI provider
